name: toolkit
description: Optional utilities for the workshop: html-report (report to a polished dark HTML page, from a doc or from session findings), arch-map (derived architecture maps), ui-demo-video (Playwright walkthroughs with verification frames), writing-skills (TDD for skill authoring, derived from obra/superpowers, MIT), and adopt-global-rules (installs the workshop's shipped global CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md and rules onto a machine, additively). Install alongside workbench when you want them; skip to keep sessions lean.

interface.longDescription: A Codex manifest for the Agent Workshop toolkit plugin. Codex exposes the html-report, ui-demo-video, arch-map, writing-skills, and adopt-global-rules skills from this package — the optional layer next to the workbench plugin.
defaultPrompt: Turn a markdown report into a standalone HTML page.
Draw an architecture map of a subsystem or refactor as a standalone page.
Record a UI demo video of a change in the running app.
Author or edit a skill with baseline testing.
Install the workshop's global CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and rules onto this machine.
